52/G.goal: Formulate and solve a time-constrained VR tour optimization problem that maximizes point-of-interest importance within a cybersickness time threshold by using a vehicle routing with profit model and solver.
52/G.achieves: It prepares the learner to apply an optimization technique in the course's system development stage, supporting the aim of building XR systems with confidence and appropriate cybersickness controls.

52/O1.goal: Formulate a time-constrained VR tour optimization model that maximizes point-of-interest importance while respecting a cybersickness exposure time threshold and node waiting times.
52/O1.achieves: It lets the learner express the navigation-path optimization part of an XR system as a defined problem that balances experience value against cybersickness limits.

52/O2.goal: Describe how to solve the formulated VR tour optimization problem by recasting it as a vehicle routing problem with profit and using a graph transformation with a VRPP solver to obtain the optimal path.
52/O2.achieves: It lets the learner apply an established optimization method to generate a value-maximizing and cybersickness-aware VR tour path for an XR system.
